events.description: Students are welcome to attend the Statistics and Data Science Alumni Career Virtual Panel hosted by the Piper Center
events.title: Statistics and Data Science Alumni Career Virtual Panel

events.description:
All are invited to join the Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science Department in welcoming well-known Mathematician Po-Shen Loh to campus to speak about his experience building an ecosystem merging live-streaming, theater, and mathematics to simultaneously teach creativity and love for humanity. Reception with the speaker to follow. 

This event is free and open to the public.
events.title: Math Across the Cannon Public Lecture: Po-Shen Loh
